Looking at this question about the Luecken et al. 2019 Cell paper on single-cell multi-omic integration of brain cell identity, I need to determine which analysis achieved the highest resolution.

The paper performed integrated analysis of single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA) and single-cell DNA methylation data. When comparing the different analyses performed in the paper, the integrated scRNA/methylation analysis provided the highest resolution in distinguishing cell types and subtypes, as combining both modalities allowed for more granular separation of cell populations than either modality alone or region-specific analyses.

[ANSWER]B[/ANSWER]
